label: athlete plays for team
definition: Athlete X plays or has played for sports team Y.
scope_notes: Selected after inspecting the entire relation: player/team positions, scoring-for and athletic team membership form the largest coherent subgroup behind the overloaded lead and give paths. Explicit player, center, wing, guard, scorer and playing/scoring-for qualify. Competitive leads over opponents, coaching/management, political leadership, communication, support, constitutional powers and disease are competing meanings, not additions to this predicate.

facts.reason: Richard Jefferson is the Nets scorer and paces or leads the team; the scorer role establishes athlete-to-team membership.
Mr. Bush leading or running ahead of Mr. Gore describes a political competitor relationship, not an athlete playing for a team.
Riley benches, removes and plays Starks as a selected player; that is management of another person, not Riley playing for Starks as a team.
Kovalev scores for Rangers and is their wing, establishing player membership. Transfer-from and generic give paths are additional meanings.
Michael Jordan scores points for Bulls and is their player and star; this explicitly supports the athlete-to-team relation.
